neighbours.label: ' the' opening a place-within-the-country slot after a named country, where a capital, city or region is expected ('In Vietnam, ... moved ... to the')
fire: In Cambodia, many rural families have moved from the villages to the capital.
In Bolivia, most young workers have migrated from the mines to the cities.
In Kenya, many farmers have left the countryside for the capital.
In Bangladesh, poor families keep moving from the delta to the big cities.
In Ghana, many traders have relocated from the north to the coast.
In Nepal, many young people have moved from the mountains to the valley.
In Ethiopia, many herders have migrated from the lowlands to the capital.
In Thailand, many laborers have shifted from the farms to the capital.
quiet: At school, many small children have moved from the hallway to the gym.
In our office, most young workers have moved from the desks to the kitchen.
On the ship, many sailors have left the deck for the galley.
In Bangladesh, poor families keep growing rice and selling the grain.
In Ghana, many traders have sold the last of their cloth.
In Nepal, many young people have read the new novel.
In Ethiopia, many herders have fed the goats before dawn.
In Thailand, many laborers have washed the trucks by noon.

notes: Probe: 'In Vietnam ... to the' 0.81, 'its capital' 0.32, 'the country's' 0.30; 'walked across the park' 0.01, 'read the book' 0.01. Fires before the noun, so 'to the capital' and 'to the coast' read the same (0.81). Output direction: the - pole promotes ' city', ' town'.
